description: Team GLAMASY is a team of six passionate, creative, and curious young innovators joining the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. United by our interest in science, technology, and space exploration, we combine our ideas, knowledge, and unique skills to solve real-world challenges using NASA's open data. Through teamwork, creativity, and collaboration, we aim to turn our ideas into meaningful and innovative solutions.
summary:
SPACE X is a rocket shooting and survival game developed by TEAM GLAMASY using Scratch. Players control a rocket and shoot incoming meteorites to earn points while protecting their spacecraft from collisions. The game begins with three lives. Whenever a meteorite hits the rocket, one life is deducted. When all three lives are lost, the game ends. The goal is to destroy as many meteorites as possible, survive, and achieve the highest score. Our project aims to make space-themed gaming enjoyable while encouraging curiosity about outer space. We also plan to include educational information about asteroids, meteoroids, and meteorites to connect the gameplay with real space science.
SPACE X represents our creativity, teamwork, and determination as first-time student game developers. Through this project, we explored programming, learned new skills, and turned our ideas into a playable game.
details:
SPACE X is a space adventure game created by TEAM GLAMASY using Scratch. The game allows players to control a spaceship and explore outer space while avoiding asteroids and other obstacles. Players can collect stars and power-ups to gain points and try to survive for as long as possible. The game includes a score system and a heart system to show the player's progress and remaining lives.

We developed this project to make space-themed learning and exploration more enjoyable for young players. It combines entertainment, creativity, and basic problem-solving through an interactive game.

We used Scratch to build and program the game. We also used ChatGPT to guide us through Scratch coding steps, YouTube tutorials to understand programming techniques, and Google Chrome to search for background images and visual resources.

All members of TEAM GLAMASY are first-time participants in game development. We are students, and some of us are also active sports players. Balancing schoolwork, sports activities, and project development gave us limited time to work together. Because of these challenges, our game is not yet fully complete and may still have flaws. However, its basic features are functional, and the game can be played.

We are proud of what we have achieved as beginners. SPACE X represents our teamwork, creativity, determination, and willingness to learn new skills and turn our ideas into reality.
